messages:
Tess: FYI tiny-infer tail latency jumped in us-west1d at 04:10. lots of 1GPU pods Pending -> Preempted.
Omar: can you paste the quick events?
Tess: scheduler events show `FailedAttach` then `Preempted` repeatedly. warmpool count collapsed 150 -> 32 in ~18m.
Lina: packing telemetry shows the new hetero-binpack rule prioritized `nvlink=true` racks for throughput jobs. apparently one tenants long-seq batch pinned 6 NVLink nodes. small replicas starved.
NetOps: also seeing elevated conntrack on racks r7-r9, attach latencies spiking where those long jobs landed.
infra-bot: ALERT: us-west1d warmpool depletion at 8675309320. affected small pods: 88. preemptions: 170.
Omar: immediate options: 1) rollback hetero-binpack tweak (disruptive), 2) bump warmpool min for the AZ, 3) apply a quick mutator to tag small pods `placement.hint=latency` so scheduler prefers warm nodes.
Lina: mutator is fastest. I'll deploy an admission webhook to label pods with `gpu==1` and `annotations.seq_len < 600` -> `placement.hint=latency`.
Tess: infra, can you bump warmpool: `kubectl -n infra patch warmpool us-west1d -p '{"spec":{"minSize":170}}'`?
NetOps: starting to drain r8 for conntrack rehab, ETA ~20m. r7 and r9 still elevated.
infra-bot: ACTION: warmpool.minSize updated at 8675309355. mutator rollout started at 8675309360.
Lina: mutator applied. scheduler now sees `placement.hint=latency` on new tiny pods.
Omar: early indicators: pending queue halved within 4m, small pod admissions resumed onto warm nodes. nvlink error logs dropping.
Tess: still seeing a cohort of bounced pods that were rescheduled multiple times; they kept hitting attach timeout window. we should add a small-pod attach-retry backoff to avoid immediate reschedule->preempt loops.
SRE Oncall: agreed. follow-ups: 1) add `attach_retry_backoff` for latency-sensitive pods, 2) add per-rack `seq_len_skew` telemetry, 3) make `nvlink` affinity a topology hint not a hard pack preference.
Lina: I'll open PR to cap packing concentration per rack to 60% long-seq and include spill-aware fallback. PR: github.com/redwood/packers/pull/2037
NetOps: r8 drain in progress; conntrack backlog decreasing. attach latencies trending to normal.
infra-bot: RESOLVED: warmpool recovered at 8675309464. preempt rate back to baseline at 8675309470.
Tess: filing incident ticket with traces and scheduler dump. adding runbook note: if warmpool < 30% baseline, bump to baseline+20% and deploy latency mutator.
Omar: adding runbook addendum: when packing changes touch nvlink preference, run a canary to measure per-rack seq skew for 1 hour.
Lina: extra action: I'll add an admission mutator test in CI to validate `placement.hint` label on small pods so it can be toggled quickly.
SRE Oncall: thanks all. let's review packer spill policy in next ops sync and include simulated taint/conntrack scenarios.
